_comment: Blood Sun step 3 (design 9.4): BLOOD SUN'S ETB DRAW FIRES FOR A CAST ENCHANTMENT (etb_self_draw: 1, the Ice-Fang /
Astrolabe family on a non-creature, non-artifact permanent). Four Mountains, Blood Sun the only card in hand, every
draw a Lightning Bolt, the opponent at 3. The human casts Blood Sun ({2}{R}); its enter trigger draws the Bolt, and
the next frame casts that Bolt off the fourth Mountain -- the line exists only if the draw happened. The
autonomous twin (rollout + executor) is bloodsun_sun_then_karoo_untapped_funds_cast.json, whose kill needs the drawn Bolt.
